Concurrent depth=2 crawl correctly fans out and deduplicates across levels

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine_config = { 'max_concurrent' => 3, 'max_depth' => 2 }
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config.to_json)
url = 'https://example.com'
result = Crawlberg.crawl(engine, url)
puts result.pages.length.inspect
```
